trainers.instruction: Drag and order the words to form the correct future perfect tense formula.

feedback.end:
The future perfect tense is used to show that an action will have been completed in the future.

It is formed with the helping words 'will,' 'have' and the past participle form of a verb.

trainers.instruction: Fill in the gap with the future perfect form of the verb.
trainers.hint:
To form the future perfect tense, you need the helping words 'will,' 'have' and the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
She will have done the work.

atoms.b: I ((will_have_slept)) by the time they arrive.
My teacher ((will_have_written)) the email by Friday.
We ((will_have_taught)) our dog some tricks by next year.
Max ((will_have_found)) a solution for this problem.
